import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('task/init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']

for row in ws.iter_rows():
    for c in row:
        c.font = Font(name='等线')

    raw = ws.cell(r,14).value
    reg = min(raw, 40)
    ot = raw - 40 if raw > 40 else ''
    ws.cell(r,14).value = reg
    ws.cell(r,15).value = ot
    # formatting
    for col in (14,15,16):
        c = ws.cell(r,col)
        v = c.value
        if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
            if float(v).is_integer():
                c.number_format = 'General'
            else:
                c.number_format = '#,##0.##'
        else:
            c.number_format = 'General'
wb.save('task/output.xlsx')
"
